title: Qualitative analysis of positive radial singular solutions on hyperbolic space
summary: We investigate positive radial solutions with an isolated nonremovable singularity for the semilinear elliptic equation \begin{align*} Δ_{\mathbb{H}^N} u+λu+u^p=0 \qquad\text{in }\mathbb{H}^N\setminus\{Q\}, \end{align*} where $N\geq 3$, $p>1$, $λ\le \frac{(N-1)^2}{4}$, and $Q\in\mathbb{H}^N$ is a prescribed pole. Our purpose is to describe how the locally Euclidean singular behavior near ${\{Q}\}$ interacts with the genuinely hyperbolic dynamics at infinity, and how this interaction changes across the Serrin and Sobolev critical exponents.
